test_title: PYST 7: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Direction: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. This is the man(A) / who I think (B)/ had stolen the bag(C)/ in the train(D).
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the phrase **"who I think"** because the relative pronoun is functioning as the object of the verb "think."
 
• In such cases, the grammatically correct usage is **"whom"** instead of "who."
 
• Therefore, the correct phrase should be **"whom I think"** to maintain proper subject-object agreement.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part B** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **B**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"This is the man **whom I think had stolen the bag in the train**."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A: "This is the man"** – Grammatically correct, no error here.
 
• **C: "had stolen the bag"** – Correct usage of past perfect tense, no error.
 
• **D: "in the train"** – Correct prepositional phrase, no error.
 
• **No error** – Not applicable, since part B contains a clear grammatical mistake.
